import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import native, layout, fib, main as M
from protocol import parse_request
cases=parse_request(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read())
native.try_build()
for ci,case in enumerate(cases):
    versions=fib.publish(case["initial"],case["transactions"])
    per=[[] for _ in versions]
    for version,repeat,addresses in case["bursts"]:
        starts=versions[version][0]
        per[version].append((repeat,[fib.run_index(starts,a) for a in addresses]))
    lay=native.plan(versions,per,case["costs"],case["cache_pages"])
    for i,(starts,hops) in enumerate(versions):
        if not M.check_layout(starts,hops,lay[i]):
            print("case",ci,"version",i,"REJECTED; R",len(starts))
            print("starts increasing:", all(a<b for a,b in zip(starts,starts[1:])), starts[0]==0)
            for idx,n in enumerate(lay[i]):
                print("  ",idx,n,"legal",layout.legal(n,starts))
            sys.exit(0)
print("all accepted")
EOF
